title: Managing your hives in Hive Pal: setup, boxes, frame sizes and analytics
summary: Everything about hives in Hive Pal: create a hive with a feature photo and base inspection frequency, see what the daily alerts flag, follow a season on the Analytics charts, and set up the box stack in detail: box types, frame sizes including your own, frame counts, colours, queen excluders, winterizing and maintenance. We finish with the seasons inherited from the apiary, the sidebar actions, QR codes, the LLM prompt, and archiving a hive.
